evals.prompt: Upgrade this Maven service from Java 8 to Java 11. It uses JAXB for XML payloads and @PostConstruct in a few beans.
evals.expected_output: A green build on JDK 11 with explicit JAXB and javax.annotation dependencies added, no --add-modules hacks, and a PR with before/after test counts.
expectations: Records a Java 8 baseline (build, test count) before changing the Java version
Runs the OpenRewrite Java8toJava11 recipe on JDK 8, or states why it was skipped
Adds jakarta.xml.bind-api 2.3.x plus jaxb-runtime and jakarta.annotation-api 1.3.x, keeping javax.* packages
Does not add --add-modules java.xml.bind or other removed-module workarounds
Replaces legacy GC logging flags with -Xlog:gc* where they exist
Reports the same test count on JDK 11 as on the baseline

evals.prompt: Move our Gradle project from Java 11 to 17. Gradle wrapper is 6.8, we use Lombok 1.18.12 and Mockito 3.
evals.expected_output: Wrapper upgraded to at least 7.3 in its own commit before the JDK switch, Lombok and Mockito upgraded, build green on 17 without --add-opens.
expectations: Upgrades the Gradle wrapper to 7.3 or later before switching the toolchain to 17
Uses a toolchain without also setting sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility
Upgrades Lombok to at least 1.18.22 and Mockito to at least 4
Does not add --add-opens when a library upgrade resolves the InaccessibleObjectException
Creates and updates MIGRATION_PLAN.md with baseline and verification sections

evals.prompt: Upgrade this app from Java 17 to 21. There's a custom ImmutableList class with getFirst() and reversed() methods, and a model class called Record.
evals.expected_output: Compile errors from sequenced collections and the Record name clash fixed with minimal, mechanical edits; no unrelated refactors.
expectations: Identifies the sequenced-collections clash on the custom collection's getFirst()/reversed()
Fixes the Record ambiguity with an explicit import rather than renaming the domain class
Mentions UTF-8 default charset and CLDR 42 time-format changes as behavior risks to check
Does not introduce records, virtual threads or other new language features

evals.prompt: We're on Java 21 with Spring Boot 3.4, Lombok 1.18.30 and MapStruct. Take us to Java 25.
evals.expected_output: Lombok, JaCoCo and bytecode libraries upgraded to Java 25-capable versions, annotation processors declared explicitly, Spring Boot moved to a 25-capable 3.5.x patch only if needed.
expectations: Upgrades Lombok to 1.18.42 or later and JaCoCo to 0.8.14 or later
Declares Lombok and MapStruct in annotationProcessorPaths instead of relying on implicit processing or -proc:full
Checks the framework gate: Spring Boot 3.5.5+ or 4.0 for Java 25
Removes -XX:+ZGenerational/-XX:-ZGenerational and any -Djava.security.manager flags if present
Runs check-bytecode.sh 25 and reports the result

evals.prompt: Upgrade this Java 8 Spring Boot 2.3 app straight to Java 25.
evals.expected_output: The skill plans 8 → 11 → 17 → 21 hops, stops at the framework gate for 25 (Boot 2.x ends at JDK 21), and explains that Boot 3 + jakarta is a separate migration.
expectations: Plans the migration as separate LTS hops rather than one jump
Stops before the 21 → 25 hop because Spring Boot 2.x does not support Java 25
Does not start a Spring Boot 3 / jakarta migration inside the JDK hop
Tells the user clearly which hops can proceed and what blocks the last one
